<span class="hl-comment">@dataclass(frozen=True)</span>
<span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData:
    enabled: <span class="hl-type">bool</span>
    always_true: <span class="hl-type">str</span>
    nothing: <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    maybe: <span class="hl-type">bool</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>

    @classmethod
    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> from_dict(<span class="hl-kw">cls</span>, data: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]) -&gt; UserCreatedData:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">cls</span>(
            enabled=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;enabled&quot;</span>),
            always_true=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;alwaysTrue&quot;</span>),
            nothing=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;nothing&quot;</span>),
            maybe=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;maybe&quot;</span>),
            always_false=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;alwaysFalse&quot;</span>),
            flags=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;flags&quot;</span>),
        )

    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> to_dict(<span class="hl-kw">self</span>) -&gt; <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> {
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;enabled&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.enabled,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;alwaysTrue&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.always_true,
